snippet.title: [Longplay] PC/Windows - Rock Man 7 FC (4K, 60FPS)
snippet.description:
Played by xRavenXP (me).

Don't forget like, comment, subscribe and hit the notification bell icon, also share the video. Thanks for watching!

This is the longplay of the game Rock Man 7 FC, an unofficial fan-made project that takes Mega Man 7 and turns it into an NES-style game. The project first became available on March 9, 2007 and was finished on July 30, 2008. This game is exclusively for PC, it is not a rom. Mega Man 7 is known as Rockman 7: Shukumei no Taiketsu! in Japan.

The game follows the same storyline as Mega Man 7 on the Super Nintendo, including the layout of the levels and the bosses are the same. But the game also has differences, such as the lack of an introductory stage and the Robot Museum, the availability to face the 8 Robot Masters right from the start and the way some of them behave when hit. The Rush Search item does not exist in this game. The game also uses a password system similar to that used in Mega Man games for the NES.

It's a great demake, very well done, taking into account the limitations of the engine that was used, but very faithful to the original game.
I hope you enjoy the video.
